chunks: Saʿd narrated from Abū Jaʿfar, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who doubts, after he has performed sajdah, that he did not perform rukuʿ. He said: He should continue in his salat (prayer).
ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he doubts after sajdah whether he performed rukuʿ in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt during salat (prayer). If a person doubts after having gone into sajdah whether he had performed rukuʿ, he should disregard the doubt and continue his prayer.
